rubrics.justification: Generally matches a poor-quality early blastocyst with absent/degenerate ICM and TE, but it overinterprets some image details (e.g., debris/polar body, exact cavity extent) and introduces a grade 1 vs 2 ambiguity not fully resolved.
Thoroughly integrates age, prior live birth, tubal factor, AMH, endometrium, semen parameters, and lifestyle with the embryo’s poor morphology and overall prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly consistent, with embryo quality appropriately treated as dominant; minor issues include speculative inferences about cohort attrition and protocol effects without full cycle data.

Mostly aligned on morphology interpretation and counseling, but several recommendations are more speculative or not guideline-based (routine estradiol addition, DHEA/GH, broad POI genetic workup, PGT-A emphasis in a young low-yield patient).
Provides clear practical next steps for counseling, transfer follow-up, and future cycle review, though some suggestions are broader or less evidence-based than ideal.
